- Auto Buy (Wins stones; Buy Target: Best Stone / Next Stone; equips after buy)

- Auto Buy Eggs (TP to egg + HatchEgg Wins path; Egg Id + Hatch Count 1/Multi; Robux eggs excluded)

- Auto Use Potions (Skill / Win / Luck every 30s when stocked)
